Examples and Tutorials

iPA provides comprehensive example scripts demonstrating various analysis workflows across different imaging modalities.

Example Categories

SXT Examples (examples/examples_sxt/)

  • demo_SXT_partitioning.py - Radial cytoplasmic partitioning workflow

  • demo_SXT_morphology.py - Morphological feature extraction

  • demo_SXT_interaction.py - Organelle interaction analysis

  • demo_SXT_spatial_arrangement.py - Spatial distribution analysis

  • train_SXT_isg_mask_rcnn_model.py - Mask R-CNN training for ISG instance segmentation

SIM/WFM Examples (examples/examples_sim_wfm/)

  • demo_SIM_partitioning.py - SIM data partitioning

  • demo_SIM_rdf_analysis.py - Radial distribution function analysis

  • demo_SIM_WFM_interaction.py - Multi-modal interaction analysis

Cryo-ET Examples (examples/examples_et/)

  • demo_ET_morphology.py - Filament length analysis

  • demo_ET_interaction.py - Vesicle-membrane interaction analysis

Running Examples

All examples can be run directly from the command line:

# Navigate to examples directory
cd examples/examples_sxt

# Run a demo script
python demo_SXT_partitioning.py

Each example includes detailed comments and generates output in the results/ directory with corresponding log files in logs/.

For complete documentation of each module’s API, see:

  • Data Loader Module - Data loading examples

  • Processing Module - Processing workflow examples

  • Analysis Module - Analysis pipeline examples
